rationale: Create one Milestone Environmental Services platform record. SK Capital-advised affiliates remain the current controlling owner and chief executive Gabriel Rio retains significant equity. I Squared signed a definitive acquisition agreement on July 7, 2026, but the adviser still labels the transaction pending and no legal close was found, so I Squared is represented only as a signed pending incoming buyer. Facilities, wells, landfills and Milestone Carbon remain beneath the platform boundary.

supports: I Squared signed to acquire Milestone on July 7, 2026
Closing was expected in the fourth quarter of 2026 subject to conditions
The adviser continues to identify the transaction as pending

afterImage.name: Milestone Environmental Services
afterImage.description: Milestone Environmental Services is a U.S. environmental-infrastructure platform that owns and operates permitted slurry-injection and engineered-landfill facilities for liquid and solid drilling, completion and production waste. The company reports 15 facilities across Texas and New Mexico serving oil-and-gas operators in the Permian, Eagle Ford and Haynesville regions, with expansion into industrial waste. SK Capital-advised affiliates completed a controlling acquisition in October 2023, and chief executive Gabriel Rio retained significant equity. I Squared Capital signed a definitive agreement on July 7, 2026 to acquire Milestone, but the transaction remained pending as of August 19, 2026; I Squared is therefore not shown as a current owner. Individual facilities, wells, landfills and the Milestone Carbon subsidiary are not separate PortCos.

milestones.event: Intervale Capital, later renamed Amberjack Capital Partners, acquired a majority interest in predecessor American Disposal Services.
American Disposal Services changed its operating name to Milestone Environmental Services, LLC.
SK Capital completed its controlling acquisition from Amberjack, with chief executive Gabriel Rio retaining significant equity.
I Squared Capital signed a definitive agreement to acquire Milestone; the transaction remained pending and subject to closing conditions.
